create_regex_filter: create a RegexFilter instance with a regex expression to filter documents that do not match the pattern
filter_documents_regex: filter a list of Document objects by returning True when the regex finds no match in the document text
build_regex_exclusion_filter: build a RegexFilter with an exclusion_writer to save filtered-out documents to disk
test_regex_filter_match: test the RegexFilter.filter method with a Document whose text matches the compiled regex expression
review_regex_filter_class: review the RegexFilter class and its filter method that returns True when regex finds no match in doc.text
